release_name: Help: feast days, conditional Masses, trust wording
notes: Help was accurate for the app as it stood two releases ago. Adds three sections in both languages, taking Help from 8 to 10 sections: (1) Feast days and special schedules - explains the feast warning, the View the diocese document link, that a blank entry means no time was published rather than no Mass, and that both disappear after the feast; (2) Masses on certain dates only - covers the 22 rows carrying rules like Third Saturday only and the 24 marked English Mass, and states the app already applies those rules when computing the next Mass; (3) Sources and reliability, expanded - explains what Batch reconciled means and what Lower confidence - check source means, which 54 rows display. Also adds a line to the update guide pointing at the Repair app button that already sits below it. No feature or data change.
